behavioral_notes.observation: Registers a new outbound payment method with code 'check_printing' (mode 'multi', type ('bank',)). account.journal._default_outbound_payment_methods adds the 'Checks' method (data record account_payment_method_check) to bank journals when available, so 'Check' becomes selectable as an outbound payment method on bank journals.

check_number is a stored computed Char with an inverse. When the journal uses no_gap sequencing, _compute_check_number pre-fills the next sequence value; on action_post (override) a manually-sequenced check consumes the journal's check_sequence_id via next_by_id(). Uniqueness per journal is enforced by a raw-SQL @api.constrains across posted payments; values must be all-digits. check_amount_in_words is computed via currency.amount_to_text. None of this numbering/validation logic is visible in metadata.

create() auto-creates a per-journal ir.sequence (implementation 'no_gap', padding 5) as check_sequence_id; the post_init_hook create_check_sequence_on_bank_journals back-fills sequences on existing bank journals at install. check_next_number is a computed Char whose inverse guards against decreasing the number (bank rejection) and the int32 max, then writes number_next_actual on the sudo sequence.

print_checks filters payments with method code 'check_printing' not yet sent, requires one shared bank journal; for pre-printed (non-manual) journals it opens the print.prenumbered.checks transient wizard to capture the first printed number, then assigns consecutive padded numbers. do_print_checks resolves the check layout (journal.bank_check_printing_layout or company.account_check_printing_layout), raises a RedirectWarning to Accounting Settings if unset/'disabled', sets is_sent=True, and returns report_action.report_action(self). The cross-model side-effect (state -> in_process/posted, is_sent flagging, document/report generation) is not in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: res.company.account_check_printing_layout / QWeb check stub (this base module)
behavioral_notes.observation: The layout Selection ships ONLY ('disabled','None') by default; do_print_checks dereferences the chosen value as an xmlID via self.env.ref(check_layout). This base module provides the print DATA structures (_check_get_pages, _check_make_stub_pages, _check_build_page_info, INV_LINES_PER_STUB=9, multi-stub paging) but NO ir.actions.report / QWeb template -- country-specific child modules add the actual check layouts via selection_add. Out-of-the-box, printing is effectively disabled until a layout module is installed.

No frontend assets: 0 JS files, 0 XML/OWL templates, 0 registry registrations, 0 patches, no asset bundles. UI is server-rendered backend views plus a 'Print Checks' server action bound to account.payment list/kanban and a 'Print Check' button on the payment form.

it_architecture.application: account_check_printing (Check Printing Base extension component of Accounting)
information_flows: side-effect: account.payment.action_post -> consumes journal check_sequence_id (manual numbering)
side-effect: account.payment.print_checks -> print.prenumbered.checks wizard -> do_print_checks -> report_action (check PDF) + is_sent=True
side-effect: account.journal.create / post_init_hook -> creates per-journal no_gap ir.sequence

value_streams: Procure-to-Pay (disbursement tail): vendor bill -> register check payment -> assign check number -> print check -> mark sent
organization: account.group_account_user (Accounting / Billing user; gates the Print Checks action and wizard access)
policies: 1 access rule: print.prenumbered.checks wizard restricted to account.group_account_user
constraint: check_number unique per journal across posted payments (raw SQL @api.constrains)
constraint: check numbers digits-only; next number cannot decrease (bank rejection) and cannot exceed int32
metrics: Journal dashboard: num_checks_to_print (payments with method check_printing, state in_process, not yet sent)

classification.rationale: account_check_printing is a payment-method extension of the accounting (support) function: it adds nothing to the primary value chain but operationalizes the disbursement step of accounts payable. It maps to APQC 9.0 Manage Financial Resources, specifically 9.5 Process payments (accounts payable / 9.5.x pay), realized on account.payment with code 'check_printing'. No own routes, no frontend, no product or revenue logic -- it is back-office plumbing around the payment document.

standard_capabilities: 'Checks' outbound payment method on bank journals
automatic & manual check number sequencing (per-journal no_gap ir.sequence)
amount-in-words and per-journal/company check layout, margins, date label, multi-page stub settings
Print Checks server action + Print Pre-numbered Checks wizard for batch printing
stub (paid-invoice summary) data generation with VOID overflow pages
typical_fits: pay vendor bills by check from a bank journal with sequential numbering
journal dashboard count of checks awaiting printing
common_gaps: no check layout out-of-the-box: a country/bank-specific layout module (selection_add on account_check_printing_layout) is required to actually print
custom QWeb check stationery / MICR positioning and printer margin tuning
non-digit or alphanumeric check numbering schemes (blocked by digits-only constraint)
